Owns and operates a standalone aesthetic surgery practice with its own website, own brand, own contact line and its own YouTube channel and Facebook page, while simultaneously holding a full-time consultant post at a flagship Apollo unit - i.e. two revenue streams. Multiple practice locations (Apollo Hyderguda + Medini Cosmetic Surgery Centre, KPHB/Kukatpally). Premium, largely self-pay elective specialty (aesthetic/cosmetic surgery). Qualifications MBBS, MS, MCh (Plastic Surgery); surgical training at Kilpauk Medical College, Chennai. Society memberships: Association of Plastic Surgeons of India (APSI) and Indian Medical Association (IMA). Operates a second procedure-focused practice site, liposuctionhyderabad.com, which publishes the same clinic email - evidence of a multi-site marketing operation.

notes: Identity confirmed on three matching facts. (1) Three official apollohospitals.com URL families all carry the exact slug 'dr-m-shridharan' under plastic-surgeon/hyderabad, matching name + specialty + city, and the profile states he is a full-time consultant cosmetic surgeon at Apollo Hospital, HYDERGUDA - the exact branch given in the brief. (2) His own clinic site medinicosmeticsurgery.com is titled for 'Dr. M. Shridharan' as cosmetic/plastic surgeon in Hyderabad and independently lists Apollo Hospital Hyderguda alongside Medini Cosmetic Surgery Centre, Kukatpally, tying the two practices to one person. (3) Practo lists 'Dr. Shridharan, Plastic Surgeon, KPHB, Hyderabad' at Medini Cosmetic Surgery Centre - same clinic, same locality (corroborating only). CONTACT VERIFICATION: the email medinicsc@gmail.com and the phone 9000906234 were each re-checked with exact-phrase searches. Both returned https://medinicosmeticsurgery.com/contact/ - his own clinic's contact page - as a real indexed page, so both are published values rather than summary artefacts. The email search also returned https://liposuctionhyderabad.com/contact/ , a second practice site publishing the same address, which strengthens it. DELIBERATELY REJECTED: the phone 04069321004 asserted by one summary as his booking number is Apollo's CENTRAL SWITCHBOARD, not his line, and was discarded on sight. A ZoomInfo result also surfaced carrying a MASKED address '****@medinicosmeticsurgery.com'; ZoomInfo is a barred broker source and a masked address must never be completed, so nothing from it was recorded or used for banding. SOCIAL MEDIA: the Facebook and YouTube accounts recorded are the practice accounts of Medini Cosmetic Surgery Centre - the clinic he founded and which is named in the account titles - not personal accounts matched on name alone. An Instagram handle 'medinicosmeticsurgerycenter' was mentioned in a summary but NO Instagram URL appeared verbatim in any result, so instagram was left blank rather than constructed. BANDING: Apollo's several domains count as ONE official source and his own clinic site is primary self-published, so Medium is correct. Human check: published experience figures conflict badly (13 / 24 / 25+ / 32 years) and qualifications are variously given as MS ENT and MS General Surgery.
